nodes.name: ultimate-claudemd/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Client lead-magnet landing page for Joe Che's Ultimate CLAUDE.md file. Renders a hero, benefits list, and an email-capture form that POSTs first name and email to /api/lead-magnets/claudemd, showing success or error state.

nodes.name: UltimateClaudeMDPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported React page component managing form state (firstName, email, submitted, loading, error) and a handleSubmit that posts the lead to the claudemd lead-magnet API, then renders hero, benefits, and CTA sections.

nodes.name: robots.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js metadata route exporting a robots() handler that allows all user agents and points crawlers to the workshop site's sitemap.xml.

nodes.name: robots
nodes.summary: Default-exported MetadataRoute.Robots generator returning an allow-all rule for every user agent plus the absolute sitemap URL.

nodes.name: sitemap.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js metadata route exporting a sitemap() handler that lists the home page, decks domain, all giveaway pages, and the ultimate-claudemd lead magnet with change frequencies and priorities.

nodes.name: sitemap
nodes.summary: Default-exported MetadataRoute.Sitemap generator returning the workshop site's URL entries (home, decks, giveaways, lead magnets) with lastModified, changeFrequency, and priority.

nodes.name: PrepChecklistItem.tsx
nodes.summary: Presentational component rendering a numbered prep-checklist row with a title, a Required/Optional badge, and arbitrary children content styled in the workshop's purple/pink theme.

nodes.name: PrepChecklistItem
nodes.summary: Default-exported component taking number, title, required flag, and children; renders the numbered badge, title, conditional Required/Optional pill, and child content.

nodes.name: VantaHero.tsx
nodes.summary: Client hero component that lazily loads Three.js and the Vanta NET effect into a background ref, with cleanup, and overlays breadcrumb navigation plus session title and description.

nodes.name: VantaHero
nodes.summary: Default-exported component that, via useEffect, dynamically imports three and vanta.net, initializes the NET effect on a ref, destroys it on unmount, and renders breadcrumb plus session hero text.

nodes.name: tool-page-template.tsx
nodes.summary: Boilerplate starter template for interactive tool pages with [FILL IN] markers, breadcrumb, page header, empty tool body, and back link, documenting the project's styling rules.

nodes.name: ToolPageTemplate
nodes.summary: Default-exported placeholder component rendering the standard tool-page layout (breadcrumb, header, body slot, back link) with markers to replace before publishing.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the workshop theme: brand colors (dark, cream, purple, pink), Plus Jakarta font, and custom keyframes and animations (float, gradient-shift, fade-in-up, glow-pulse, shimmer).

nodes.name: giveaway-email-collection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Node test suite asserting the giveaway email-capture contract: the modal POSTs email/source/journeyId to /api/lead-magnet, client and server share the same EMAIL_RE regex, the API validates, rate-limits, persists to Supabase leads, and sends via Resend, and per-page slugs match directory names.

nodes.name: listGiveawayPages
nodes.summary: Test helper that reads the giveaways directory and returns each subdirectory's slug and page.tsx source for slug-consistency assertions.

nodes.name: extractModalSlugs
nodes.summary: Test helper that regex-extracts slug props passed to GiveawayEmailModal and GiveawayAutoModal from a page's source.

nodes.name: giveaway-template-structure.test.ts
nodes.summary: Node test suite enforcing giveaway page structure: every page imports GiveawayEmailModal (or is exempt), wires either the copy-prompt or auto-popup trigger, and inline auto-popups set showCopiedBadge to false.

nodes.name: listGiveawayPages
nodes.summary: Test helper that enumerates giveaway subdirectories and returns each slug and its page.tsx source for structural assertions.
